national_news.title: 5th Asian Para Games Begins in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan
bullets: The 5th edition of the Asian Para Games commenced in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, featuring competitions across 18 sports under the theme 'WABI: We Are Beautiful Individuals'.
India sent a 281-member delegation, including 168 athletes (112 men and 56 women) competing across 11 disciplines, aiming to surpass its previous record of 111 medals achieved at Hangzhou in 2023.
Para-badminton player Pramod Bhagat and sprinter Simran Sharma led the Indian contingent as the official flag-bearers during the opening ceremony.

national_news.title: Charles Matata Breaks Course Record at Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon
bullets: Kenya’s Charles Matata won the men’s elite race at the Vedanta Delhi Half Marathon, breaking the course record with a time of 58 minutes and 52 seconds over the 21.097-km course.
Ethiopia’s Wudinesh Alemu claimed the women’s elite title finishing in 1 hour, 6 minutes, and 35 seconds.
In the Indian elite category, Shailesh Kushwaha won the men’s race in 1:05:05, while Ankita Dhyani secured the women’s title in 1:12:46.

national_news.title: India's Space Economy Projected to Reach USD 40-45 Billion in 7-8 Years
bullets: Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh announced that India's space economy is expected to grow from USD 9 billion to USD 40-45 billion in the next 7 to 8 years.
The announcement was made during a media roundtable on 'Space, Sovereignty and New Economy' organised by the Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi.
Key growth drivers include public-private partnerships, domestic and international investments, faster regulatory approvals, and sustainable business models.
